# Lua reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from docs/eix.lua; edit that file, not this page. -->

The Lua API of a mod's main script: the functions addon.dll registers before the script runs, and the callbacks the
script defines. [Lua](lua.md) says how the host runs the script. The declarations below are annotations for the Lua
language server (LuaLS); the same text is the definitions file [eix.lua](eix.lua), in the `docs` folder of the release
package: [editor setup](lua.md#editor-setup) says how to give it to the server for completion and type checks.

## Types

The one type of this API that is not a Lua built-in.

### Pointer

```lua
---@alias Pointer integer
```

A game address, passed as the 32 bits of the address read as a signed integer: an address above 2 GB is negative. Raw
memory functions need an address that holds valid game memory. A record or slot index is zero-based and must lie inside
the table or the slots.

## Functions supplied by eix

Global functions that addon.dll registers before the main script runs. A signed 32-bit integer argument is read as Lua's
`luaL_checkinteger` reads it: a number or a numeric string, truncated. A bad argument raises LuaJIT's usual argument
error.

### Round

```lua
---@param value number
---@return number
function Round(value) end
```

Rounds half away from zero.

### IDiv

```lua
---@param a integer
---@param b integer
---@return integer
function IDiv(a, b) end
```

Signed integer quotient. A zero divisor or an overflow ends the game.

### IMod

```lua
---@param a integer
---@param b integer
---@return integer
function IMod(a, b) end
```

Signed integer remainder. A zero divisor or an overflow ends the game.

### Heal

```lua

---@param vitals Pointer
---@param amount number

```

```lua

```

Adds the maximum mana times `fraction`, capped at the maximum mana.


### GetIniValue

```lua
---@param file string
---@param section string
---@param key string
---@return string? value `nil` if the path is refused or the file, section or key is missing.
function GetIniValue(file, section, key) end
```

Reads a value from an INI file of the mod folder, at the call. File, section and key are matched without regard to case.
The file is a path below the mod folder, with `/` or `\` as separators; an absolute path, a drive letter or a `..`
component is refused with a warning in addon.log, as is a missing value (once per file, section and key). Convert a
number with `tonumber`, which wants a `.` as the decimal point.

## Callbacks supplied by the mod

Global functions that the main script defines, each called by the patch group named in its description. Every callback
is optional: where the script defines none, the game's own code runs. A callback that returns nothing updates the
structures it receives through their addresses.

### GetSkillPriceDiff

```lua
---@param from integer
---@param to integer
---@return integer cost
function GetSkillPriceDiff(from, to) end
```

### RecalcUnitStats

```lua
---@param stats Pointer
---@param vitals Pointer
---@param unit Pointer
---@param effectMaxima Pointer
function RecalcUnitStats(stats, vitals, unit, effectMaxima) end
```

Group `LuaRecalcUnitStats`. Recomputes a unit's statistics; `effectMaxima` points to 40 floats.

Differs from addon.dll 0.12.4.2: sets the alive bit in the stats' flags (the original sets it in the build flags); an
intelligence raise marks the unit changed (the original does not); a strength raise widens the unit by 0.2, as the game
does (the original narrows it by mistake); a unit without vitals is skipped (the original crashes).

### RecalcInternalHeroStats

```lua
---@param stats Pointer
---@param newLoad number
function RecalcInternalHeroStats(stats, newLoad) end
```

Group `LuaRecalcUnitStats`. Resets a hero's statistics to their base values.

Differs from addon.dll 0.12.4.2: sets the alive bit in the stats' flags (the original sets it in the build flags); an
intelligence raise marks the unit changed (the original does not); a strength raise widens the unit by 0.2, as the game
does (the original narrows it by mistake); a unit without vitals is skipped (the original crashes).

### CalcAttackParamsOnServer

```lua

```

Group `LuaCalcAttackParams`. Computes an attack's parameters on the server; `effectMaxima` points to 40 floats.

Differs from addon.dll 0.12.4.2: a hit from another player's unit is ignored unless SpellAddon's `enablekillsinmulti` is
on, as without the group (the original lets players' units always hurt each other).

### DistributeLmpExp

```lua

---@param players integer
---@return number share

```

Group `LuaLmpExpDistribution`. The share of a kill's experience for each player.

Differs from addon.dll 0.12.4.2: no value is left on the FPU stack per call (the original's leftovers corrupt later
results).
